title: Tap
prompt: A labelled teaching cutaway of the page 65 screw-operated tap is supplied by an external raised water reservoir. Open turns the handle and raises the threaded spindle and washer to let water pass to a catch basin. Close turns it back and presses the washer against its seat to stop the flow. Show the handle, fixed threaded body, spindle, washer, seat and inlet and outlet passages. Closing-force and water-flow arrows are overlays. The reservoir and basin are teaching fixtures, not extra tap machinery.
blurb: A teaching adaptation of the screw-operated tap, with an external raised reservoir and catch basin, reveals how the spindle lowers a washer onto its seat.
adaptation: Enlarged teaching model; illustrative screw pitch and flow rate; finite two-litre external water supply. Water-route and closing-force arrows are overlays. Reservoir, stand, basin and board are teaching fixtures.

editions.2016: Saved primary page 65 image and text inspected.
